Body.Content:
What and why:

PowerPoint Live now supports the Up Arrow and Down Arrow keys for navigating between slides during a presentation. This enhancement gives presenters additional, familiar keyboard options and makes slide navigation easier and more intuitive.

Rollout schedule:

  • General Availability (Worldwide, GCC, GCC High, DoD): Rollout began in mid-August 2026 and is expected to be completed by early September 2026.

Impact on your organization:

Who is affected:

  • Users who present slides with PowerPoint Live.

Platform:

  • PowerPoint Live.

After this update:

  • Presenters can use the Up Arrow and Down Arrow keys to navigate between slides.
  • Existing slide-navigation methods and input-device workflows will continue to work.
  • The additional keyboard shortcuts will be available automatically as the update rolls out.

Action required / Recommendations:

No action is required. You may update internal training or support materials to include the additional keyboard shortcuts.

Compliance considerations:

No compliance considerations identified, review as appropriate for your organization.

Details.Value: PowerPoint Live now allows slide navigation using Up and Down Arrow keys, enhancing presenter control. This update, rolling out globally from mid-August to early September 2026, requires no action but may prompt updates to training materials. Existing navigation methods remain unchanged.

message.Title: Enhanced Slide Navigation with Up and Down Arrow Keys in PPT Live
